description: EERI VERT Izmir Earthquake Phase 2 Report is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Erica Fischer, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). The EERI Virtual Earthquake Reconnaissance Team (VERT) is a team of volunteers that activate after major earthquakes to curate reports on the impact to the community. VERT activates in a series of phases after an earthquake to assist in-field teams with data-driven reconnaissance. Coverage: Izmir, Turkey. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Virtual Reconnaissance, Earthquake, Hospitals, Soft story building. Published 2020-12-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
